def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    remaining_payments = [5000, 5000, 5000]
    principal = 100000
    treasury_yield = 0.025
    spread = 0.012

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    discount_rate = treasury_yield + spread
    make_whole_call_price = sum(
        payment / ((1 + discount_rate) ** (year + 1))
        for year, payment in enumerate(remaining_payments)
    )
    make_whole_call_price += principal / ((1 + discount_rate) ** len(remaining_payments))

    answer = round(make_whole_call_price)

    # return answer
    return answer
